description: Project general facts This rises as an architectural statement of modern luxury, distinguished by clean contours, cascading green terraces, and an iconic vertical silhouette. The tower's exterior harmonizes natural elements with contemporary aesthetics, creating an elevated urban oasis. Expansive balconies wrapped in lush greenery and panoramic glazing ensure every residence enjoys a seamless indoor-outdoor connection, while the layered faсade gives the building a sculptural, dynamic presence on the skyline. Inside, it offers refined residences where elegant design meets functional sophistication. Warm textures, soft color palettes, and high-end contemporary detailing create a calm and inviting atmosphere. Spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and thoughtful lighting enhance the feeling of openness, while premium craftsmanship elevates every corner of the home. Each residence is designed to embody comfort, beauty, and effortless modern living. The project delivers an exceptional lifestyle through its collection of world-class amenities. Residents can enjoy sky-level experiences including a rooftop lounge and infinity pool, floating cabanas, panoramic glass yoga room, and a dedicated spa with sauna, steam, and jacuzzi. Entertainment spaces such as the 3D/6D cinema room, table games lounge, and sky cinema complement family-friendly features like kids' pools and play areas. Fitness and leisure are equally prioritized with a fully equipped gym, padel court, jogging track, rooftop garden, and immersive laser-light experiences. Additional conveniences include retail and office spaces with private entrances, multi-level parking, and excellent connectivity to major roads, schools, clinics, and future metro access. Every residence is crafted with an exceptional standard of quality, showcasing premium materials and refined finishing that elevate the living experience. Soft textures, elegant surfaces, and thoughtfully selected details create a polished, timeless atmosphere. Kitchens come fully equipped with modern fittings and high-quality cabinetry, offering both functionality and sophistication for everyday use. Delivered unfurnished, each home becomes a blank canvas - allowing residents to personalize their space and express their individual style while enjoying the project's solid foundation of luxury, craftsmanship, and design excellence. Location description and benefits Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) is a sprawling and diverse community located in Dubai, offering a multitude of entertainment, leisure, and residential opportunities. This vibrant community is renowned for its wide range of attractions and experiences, making it a unique destination that caters to residents and visitors of all ages. At the heart of Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) is its extensive array of world-class entertainment and leisure destinations. The community is home to numerous theme parks, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, which features Legoland, Motiongate, Bollywood Parks, and the immersive waterpark experience of Legoland Water Park. These attractions provide endless fun and entertainment for families, creating memorable experiences for both children and adults alike. Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) also boasts a variety of sporting facilities and outdoor spaces, catering to the needs of sports enthusiasts and those seeking an active lifestyle. This project offers waterfront living with world-class amenities, fully furnished residences, and a flexible 1% monthly payment plan, delivering a first of its kind branded lifestyle in the UAE capital. Brabus Abu Dhabi (also known as Brabus Island) is developed by Reportage Properties in collaboration with its high-end brand Cosmo Developments . It marks the BRABUS automotive brand's first venture into luxury real estate , bringing the same cutting-edge design and uncompromising quality to an exclusive residential community. Set on its own island in Al Raha Beach's Al Seef district, the project features four high-rise towers with 350 ultra-luxury apartments and an additional 100 villas (including twin villas, townhouses, and beach villas). The concept fuses Brabus's signature automotive-inspired style with contemporary architecture, creating a distinctive "Home of the WOW" lifestyle unique to Abu Dhabi. Every aspect of the design is bold and modern from sleek façades with striking curves to meticulously crafted interiors echoing the unmistakable BRABUS DNA in a residential form . Location is a prime selling point. Brabus Abu Dhabi is strategically located in Al Raha Beach, a prestigious waterfront community in Abu Dhabi. Residents will enjoy direct beach access to pristine sand and sea, as well as scenic canal views around the island. Despite the private island setting, connectivity is excellent - the development lies just 10 minutes from Abu Dhabi International Airport and about 20 minutes from the city center (Corniche area). Major attractions are within easy reach: the famed Yas Island entertainment zone (home to Ferrari World and Etihad Arena) is 15-20 minutes' drive, while the cultural hubs on Saadiyat Island (including the Louvre Abu Dhabi museum) are only 25 minutes away . Even Dubai is accessible in about an hour by car. In short, residents can enjoy serene island luxury minutes away from key landmarks and highways, balancing exclusivity with convenience. Lifestyle & Design: Brabus Abu Dhabi promises a one-of-a-kind living experience combining ultra-luxury and the flair of an iconic supercar brand. Each apartment is crafted to the highest standards, featuring expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning panoramic sea views. Interiors boast premium finishes and smart-home technology for modern comfort, including state-of-the-art climate control and branded fixtures. Future owners can choose from three exclusive interior themes - Black & Bold, Gray Haven, or White Bliss each palette inspired by BRABUS's legendary custom cars to reflect a sleek and sophisticated ambiance. All residences come fully furnished with bespoke contemporary pieces and top-quality fittings, right down to custom furniture and stylish lighting, providing a turnkey luxury home from day one. Every detail, from the kitchen layouts to the bathroom fixtures, has been thoughtfully designed to exude elegance and ensure an "instant wow" factor. As an off-plan project, Brabus Abu Dhabi is scheduled for completion by Q1 2029. This timeline gives investors and end-users a comfortable window for payment and planning. The development is freehold for all nationalities, backed by one of the UAE's reputable developers, which adds to its investment appeal. Whether you're a discerning homeowner or a savvy investor, this project represents a rare opportunity - the combination of a branded residence, prime waterfront location, and flexible payment terms means high potential for capital appreciation and rental demand. In essence, Brabus Abu Dhabi delivers not just a home, but a statement in luxury living, set to become a new landmark in Abu Dhabi's real estate landscape. title: 58HF+X8, Dubai
description: The Symphony by Imtiaz presents a distinctive vision of contemporary luxury, where sculptural architecture, fluid forms, and refined design come together in a harmonious residential concept. Inspired by the architectural philosophy associated with Zaha Hadid, the development embraces expressive curves, geometric precision, and the interplay of light and shadow to create a striking architectural presence. Every element reflects a considered balance between artistic expression and everyday functionality, offering a sophisticated living environment shaped by design and tranquillity. Residences and interiors The residential collection includes elegant 1-bedroom apartments, spacious duplex residences, and refined master suites. Interiors are designed around natural textures, soft lighting, and seamless transitions between living spaces, creating an atmosphere of openness and calm. Open-plan kitchens connect effortlessly with living and dining areas, while private balconies extend the living experience outdoors, framing views of the surrounding cityscape. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximise space and functionality while maintaining the development's distinctive design language. The result is a contemporary home environment where architectural character meets comfort and understated elegance. Amenities and lifestyle The Symphony offers a curated range of amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and social connection. The clubhouse features inviting lounge areas, billiards, and a dedicated reading corner, providing comfortable spaces for leisure and interaction. The fitness studio is equipped for mindful movement and full-body training, while the landscaped podium garden introduces a tranquil green retreat within the development. Rooftop and social spaces provide additional settings for relaxation, gathering, and enjoying the surrounding views. Across these shared spaces, thoughtful design and natural elements contribute to an atmosphere of contemporary sophistication. Finishes and smart-home features The interiors combine modern aesthetics with high-quality materials and carefully selected international brands. Bathrooms feature sanitaryware by Villeroy & Boch, technical solutions from Geberit, and designer fittings by Gessi, adding a refined touch to everyday routines. Kitchens and household areas may include appliances from leading brands such as Bosch and Samsung. Smart-home features integrated with Alexa offer added convenience, supporting a more seamless and connected living experience. Together, these details reinforce the development's emphasis on quality, functionality, and considered design. Location and lifestyle Located in Meydan City, The Symphony benefits from a prestigious Dubai address that combines contemporary residential living with open spaces and access to major city destinations. The area is known for the iconic Meydan Racecourse, home to the renowned Dubai World Cup, which brings international attention and a distinctive sporting atmosphere to the neighbourhood. Meydan City also features landscaped gardens, parks, and tree-lined streets, offering opportunities for outdoor recreation, walking, cycling, and community activities. These green spaces provide a welcome contrast to Dubai's dynamic urban environment. With road connections to key destinations across Dubai, Meydan offers access to business districts, shopping venues, dining destinations, and entertainment options. Its combination of modern infrastructure, recreational surroundings, and a prominent address makes it an appealing location for residents seeking a balance between city convenience and a more tranquil residential setting. The Symphony brings together expressive architecture, premium interior details, and thoughtfully designed lifestyle amenities to create a distinctive residential experience in Meydan City.

description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

title: Dubai Islands, Dubai
description: Ocean Tower by Ahmed Al Ansari Real Estate Development is a contemporary residential tower that combines a refined waterfront lifestyle with a resort-style amenity offering. The building rises above a ground floor and a two-level parking podium to a rooftop, standing taller than many neighbouring buildings and occupying an unusually large plot. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected residences opening towards ocean views and a sky lounge providing elevated vistas across the surrounding waterfront. Amenities are designed around relaxation, wellness and an active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a lazy river, an infinity swimming pool and a jacuzzi, alongside a sauna, indoor and outdoor gyms and an outdoor yoga area. Sports facilities include a padel tennis court, a badminton court, table tennis and a dedicated jogging track. Families benefit from a kids' playground with a sand area and mini golf, while a billiards room and lounge areas create relaxed spaces for socialising with friends and neighbours. Interiors feature contemporary finishes and high-quality materials, with bright living spaces planned around comfort and everyday practicality. Kitchens are fully equipped with fitted appliances, ready for daily cooking and entertaining. Bedrooms offer calm, private retreats, and bathrooms are finished with modern fixtures and fittings. Residences are delivered with fitted kitchens and without furniture, giving owners the flexibility to personalise their interiors to their own taste and style. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a coastal master community by Nakheel on the Deira waterfront, combining an extensive public beachfront, marinas, golf courses, a community park and a wide choice of resorts and hotels. The islands offer a relaxed, resort-style environment with sunset views across the water. A waterfront marina with space for restaurants and cafes sits close to many residential plots, adding a lively setting by the water. The Infinity Bridge links the islands to the mainland, placing Al Mamzar Beach, Deira City Centre, the Gold Souq and Dubai Hospital a short drive away. Dubai International Airport is also within easy reach, and the wider road network connects residents with Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and the rest of the city. Beaches, waterfront dining and hotels on the islands keep leisure close to home, while schools, clinics and supermarkets in neighbouring Deira cover everyday needs. Dubai Islands is a freehold destination that appeals to end users seeking beachfront living close to the city and to investors focused on premium rental demand. Its resort-style setting, marinas and proximity to the airport support both long-term and holiday rentals. As one of Dubai's key coastal master plans, the community offers strong potential for long-term value, supported by growing hospitality and leisure infrastructure across the islands.

On the island, there are island residences, a neighborhood, glamorous 5-star hotels, residences, modern entertainment venues, beaches, and walking paths. Ocean House Project is one of the luxury housing projects located on Palm Jumeirah Island. The services and social facilities in this 9-story building offer luxury and comfort together to make you feel privileged. The project provides shared areas with lobby service, cinema and game room, meeting rooms, kitchen, and chef service, a spa and health club, aroma therapy, massage pool, steam and sauna rooms, halotherapy with Himalayan rock salt, yoga, and training halls. Some apartments have a private pool, but there is also a 50 m Olympic pool open to public use and a separate children's pool that allows all members of your family to have fun. Since pools and other social facilities are connected to each other, you can have fun all day long and live in your own home in a holiday atmosphere. European-style architectural touches have been preferred in the interiors of the . Antibacterial paints and materials used on air conditioning grilles, door designs, and wet floors have been chosen to ensure that you live a calm, healthy, and fresh life inside. Miele/Franke brand white goods (refrigerator, oven, stove, hood, washing machine, and dishwasher) were preferred in the kitchens. Italian marble was used on the countertops. Metal details in copper tones were preferred. The external structure is built in accordance with nature-friendly green building criteria. Special areas also are reserved for recycling in the apartments. All apartment types have caretaker rooms, built-in dressing areas, and laundry areas. Kitchens are divided into two: a cooking area and a presentation area. All apartments also have gardens and balconies. DXB-00003

Imagine stepping out of your luxury tower directly onto beautifully landscaped walkways, where high-end retail stores, artisanal cafes, and essential services are all within a few minutes' stroll. This layout creates a harmonious balance between the privacy of residential life and the energy of a bustling commercial hub. This zone does not exist in isolation; it is seamlessly abutted by two other distinct districts: Al Mamsha Souks and Al Mamsha Seerah. While the Souks offer a nod to traditional Arabian commerce and vibrant marketplaces, and Seerah focuses on residential tranquility and wellness, Raseel acts as the modern, high-tech core. Together, these three zones form a comprehensive ecosystem where residents can work, live, and play without ever needing to leave the neighborhood. Connectivity and Prime Location One of the most compelling features of this 1-bedroom apartment is its central location. Nama 3 offers residents a 'best of both worlds' scenario: the cultural and educational richness of Sharjah paired with the commercial proximity of Dubai. * Education and Commerce: The apartment is a mere 5 minutes away from University City of Sharjah, home to prestigious academic institutions, making it an ideal rental choice for faculty and graduate students. The Sharjah Industrial Area is also just 5 minutes away, catering to professionals working in the city's economic heart. * Retail and Leisure: For premium shopping and dining, the 06 Mall is reachable within a 5-minute drive. If you are looking for green spaces, the lush Dubai National Park is just a 10-minute commute. * Travel Hubs: Global connectivity is a breeze. Sharjah International Airport is only 10 minutes away, while Dubai International Airport (DXB) can be reached in approximately 15 minutes, making this a perfect residence for frequent travelers and international business professionals. Why Invest in Nama 3? The 1-bedroom units in Nama 3 are designed with the modern minimalist in mind, featuring open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light, and premium materials throughout. As Sharjah continues to grow as a cultural and economic powerhouse, properties within integrated communities like Al Mamsha Raseel are expected to see significant capital appreciation and high rental yields. Whether you are a first-time buyer looking for a stylish sanctuary or an investor eyeing the lucrative UAE real estate market, this apartment in Nama 3 offers a lifestyle defined by convenience, luxury, and connectivity. title: Sector 3, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1214. Discover a new residential icon in the heart of Dubai: an extraordinary 147 m² 2-bedroom flat with sea views, set in a 450-metre-high, 109-storey tower that redefines the concept of living above the city. Located on the prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road, this development elevates the urban experience by combining excellent architecture, stunning panoramic views and an immediate connection to the most relevant areas of Dubai. Just minutes from Business Bay, DIFC, Downtown and Jumeirah Beach, it offers a strategic location that ensures mobility, convenience and the privilege of living in the centre of it all. This spacious 147 m² T2 flat has been designed as a contemporary refuge where spaciousness, light and comfort meet in perfect harmony. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame magnificent views of the sea and skyline, allowing natural light to fill each room and creating a warm and inspiring atmosphere. The private balcony extends this connection to the landscape, transforming every moment outdoors into a true sensory experience. Inside, the superior quality finishes stand out: porcelain floors, fully equipped kitchen with appliances from recognised brands and bathrooms covered with premium materials. The integrated technology allows lighting and climate control to be controlled, ensuring a modern, functional environment adjusted to the urban lifestyle. The tower also offers four sky-parks distributed vertically, each conceived as an independent universe suspended in the air. From family areas and leisure spaces, to levels dedicated to well-being with a jogging track, yoga areas and garden terraces, to tranquil gardens ideal for relaxation everything culminates in an upper sky-park, located about 370 meters high, where an infinity pool and a floating deck create a true resort experience with impressive views of the sea and the city. The experience begins in the lobby, a space carefully designed to convey serenity and grandeur through the balanced use of stone, wood, and metal elements that filter light in a gentle way. Every detail, from the entrance to the highest levels, has been designed to reflect lightness, verticality and a contemporary aesthetic that accompanies modern urban life. Scheduled for completion in December 2031, this 2-bedroom sea view represents a unique investment opportunity in one of Dubai's tallest and most impressive residential developments. description: Inspired by nature and crafted by the sea, PASSO by BEYOND is a bold new residential icon and masterpiece on the crescent of Palm Jumeirah. This stunning development, comprising two sculptural towers, offers a curated collection of 625 residences, including 1-6 bedroom apartments, exclusive penthouses, and six standalone beach mansions. PASSO's architecture is a reflection of nature's everlasting metamorphosis-a bold expression of fluid design and elevated living with dynamic facades and lush, sensory landscapes that evoke a sense of rhythm, balance, and calm. With a 250-meter private beachfront and a host of resort-level amenities, PASSO is not just a place to live; it's a place to move, breathe, and belong. PASSO: Shaped by Nature's Most Powerful Forces. Set on one of the last prime locations on the Palm Jumeirah crescent, PASSO by Beyond offers an address that needs no introduction. Surrounded by the Arabian Gulf on one side and the stunning Dubai skyline on the other, this location provides exceptional privacy, uninterrupted sea views, and a sense of tranquility that is unmatched within the city. The architecture is an iconic contemporary statement, drawing direct inspiration from nature's powerful forces, from layered stone formations to coastal curves shaped by wind and water. The two towers, Avita and Bella, feature a dynamic flow and terraced edges that offer 360-degree viewing opportunities, blending seamlessly into a lush, landscaped podium that cascades toward a 40-meter wide white sand beach. The PASSO experience is a rich lifestyle journey woven through architecture and nature, offering residents a unique resort and leisure experience within a residential project. The myriad of amenities is carefully distributed across multiple levels, creating various attractions that benefit from the surrounding views. Whether it's a sunrise walk on the private beach, an afternoon yoga session in the Wellness Pavilion, a sunset gathering on the Social Deck, or a dip in a sky pool with breathtaking views, residents can tailor multiple, preference-based experiences. From the grand Arrival Piazza to the multi-tiered pools with infinity edges and beachfront cabanas, every detail is thoughtfully integrated into daily life to evoke a sense of balance and calm. The Residences: A refined selection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom residences offering thoughtfully designed living spaces that balance comfort, style, and everyday functionality. The Wellness Collection: Comprising 1 and 2-bedroom residences, this collection is for those who value privacy and wellbeing. Each home features a private garden with an integrated plunge pool, seamlessly extending into the lush podium landscape with direct access to greenery and the beach. The Elite Collection: A curated mix of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom residences offering generous living spaces defined by exceptional architecture and framed by breathtaking views. The Penthouses: Limited to just five rare, sky-level sanctuaries, these 4 and 5-bedroom duplex penthouses crown the highest floors of each tower. They offer private arrival with enclosed parking and a dedicated lobby, double-height living spaces, panoramic terraces, and a private plunge pool. The Beach Mansions: The pinnacle of oceanfront living, this collection is limited to six standalone 6-bedroom, yacht-inspired mansions. title: Burj Al Alam, Dubai
description: Binghatti Skyrise is a striking high-rise residential development that brings together contemporary architecture, distinctive design, and modern urban living. Comprising three elegant towers, the project features bold geometric forms, clean lines, and Binghatti's signature architectural identity, creating a remarkable presence on Dubai's skyline. The development offers a diverse selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to maximize space, functionality, and natural light. Expansive windows and well-planned layouts create bright, comfortable interiors, offering residents a stylish urban retreat in one of Dubai's most dynamic locations. Designed to complement an active and well-rounded lifestyle, Binghatti Skyrise features an extensive collection of recreational and wellness amenities. Residents can enjoy a man-made beach, jogging tracks, tennis and basketball courts, padel and badminton facilities, and a golf course overlooking a scenic lake. Landscaped gardens, indoor fitness facilities, and outdoor workout areas further enhance the experience, providing spaces for relaxation, exercise, and social interaction. The apartments feature contemporary interiors finished with quality materials and modern detailing. Equipped kitchens add everyday convenience, while the unfurnished format allows residents to personalise their homes according to their individual preferences. Combining architectural character with practical layouts and lifestyle-focused amenities, Binghatti Skyrise offers a contemporary residential experience designed for modern city living. Location: Business Bay Business Bay is one of Dubai's prominent mixed-use districts, combining residential towers, commercial offices, hotels, restaurants, and leisure destinations within a vibrant urban setting. Located adjacent to Downtown Dubai, the area offers a dynamic lifestyle with convenient access to some of the city's most recognisable attractions, business hubs, and entertainment destinations. Residents can enjoy a diverse selection of dining options, cafés, retail outlets, and hospitality venues, alongside the district's lively waterfront atmosphere. Its proximity to Downtown Dubai and major road networks makes Business Bay an appealing location for professionals, entrepreneurs, and residents seeking connectivity and convenience. Essential services, including supermarkets, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, banks, and business centres, are available within Business Bay and neighbouring communities. With its blend of modern infrastructure, urban energy, and access to key destinations, Business Bay offers a well-connected lifestyle suited to both end-users and property investors.

description: The Archive by Imtiaz reimagines contemporary residential living through a distinctive concept inspired by literature, creativity, and intellectual wellbeing. At the heart of this unique development is a curated collection of approximately 10,000 real books, creating an environment where architecture and the art of reading come together. From an impressive two-storey library featuring an elegant spiral staircase to a dedicated writer's room designed to inspire creativity, every space reflects a thoughtful approach to modern living. Amenities and lifestyle The Archive offers a carefully curated selection of amenities designed to support physical wellness, relaxation, and creative inspiration. Fitness enthusiasts can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym shaped around Imtiaz's Raw Theory wellness philosophy, while the rooftop swimming pool provides a peaceful setting to unwind. Additional amenities include a BBQ lounge, outdoor cinema, landscaped garden with floating cabanas, and a mini golf course, offering opportunities for recreation and social gatherings. Dedicated reading lounges and thoughtfully designed communal spaces further distinguish the development, creating an atmosphere that encourages quiet reflection, meaningful conversations, and a deeper appreciation of everyday life. Interiors and finishes The interiors embrace a refined, literary-inspired aesthetic, balancing contemporary design with spaces dedicated to reading, creativity, and relaxation. Reading lounges provide inviting corners for quiet moments, while the rooftop salon, featuring a fireplace and comfortable deep seating, offers an elegant setting for socialising or unwinding. Modern finishes and high-quality materials complement the architectural concept, creating interiors that combine comfort, functionality, and understated sophistication. The overall design offers a distinctive residential experience for those who appreciate thoughtful spaces and a lifestyle centred on culture and wellbeing. Location and lifestyle Situated in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), The Archive benefits from a residential setting with access to major road networks, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. This connectivity provides convenient routes to key destinations across Dubai, supporting both professional and personal lifestyles. The surrounding area offers access to shopping, entertainment, education, and leisure destinations. Popular attractions such as Dubai Outlet Mall, IMG Worlds of Adventure, and Global Village are accessible by road, while cultural and lifestyle destinations including Mohammed Bin Rashid Library, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour, and Downtown Dubai provide further options for exploration. DLRC offers a residential atmosphere away from some of Dubai's busiest central districts while maintaining road access to business hubs, retail destinations, and other key areas of the city. Its combination of everyday convenience and connectivity makes it an option for professionals, families, and investors seeking a home within Dubai's expanding residential landscape. The Archive stands apart through its distinctive literary concept, thoughtfully designed amenities, and contemporary residences, offering a lifestyle where modern comfort meets creativity, culture, and wellbeing.

description: Burj Binghatti is an iconic ultra-luxury residential tower that represents a bold architectural statement within Dubai's skyline. Rising over 112 storeys, the development is distinguished by its striking crown-inspired pinnacle, created in collaboration with the renowned luxury watch and jewellery brand Jacob & Co. Its extraordinary architectural identity combines visionary design with an exclusive residential concept, positioning the tower as a landmark destination for luxury living. The project features an exceptional collection of two- and three-bedroom suites, alongside prestigious penthouses and sky villas, each designed to offer expansive interiors, panoramic views, and an elevated residential experience. Designed around privacy, exclusivity, and refined luxury, Burj Binghatti offers a lifestyle that extends beyond conventional high-rise living. Its premium residential spaces are thoughtfully planned to provide comfort, sophistication, and exceptional city views. Among its signature offerings are the Fleur de Jardin Sky Villas, featuring half-floor layouts across the upper levels and breathtaking 180-degree views of iconic landmarks, including Burj Khalifa and Dubai Creek. These exclusive residences create an extraordinary setting for those seeking privacy and distinction at the highest level. The interiors reflect an uncompromising approach to quality, featuring premium materials, sophisticated finishes, and meticulous attention to detail. Each residence is designed to create a timeless atmosphere where elegance meets functionality. From expansive layouts to carefully selected finishes, every element contributes to a distinctive luxury living experience. Location Description & Benefits Located in Business Bay , Burj Binghatti occupies a prestigious address within one of Dubai's most established residential and commercial districts. Positioned alongside the Dubai Canal and just minutes from Downtown Dubai, the area is recognized for its impressive skyline, contemporary architecture, luxury hotels, and premium residential developments. Its central positioning offers convenient access to major destinations, including DIFC, Sheikh Zayed Road, and Dubai International Airport. Business Bay offers a vibrant lifestyle supported by an extensive selection of restaurants, cafés, luxury hotels, retail outlets, and leisure destinations. The Dubai Canal waterfront adds a scenic dimension to the neighbourhood, with promenades and walking paths providing opportunities for outdoor recreation and relaxation. Residents can also enjoy access to fitness centres, wellness facilities, and landscaped public spaces, creating a balance between the energy of city living and peaceful waterfront surroundings. The district has developed into a major business and lifestyle destination, attracting professionals, entrepreneurs, and international residents. Its proximity to Downtown Dubai, established commercial hubs, and key transport routes contributes to its continued residential appeal. Business Bay also benefits from a diverse rental market, supported by demand for centrally located homes and convenient access to Dubai's business districts. With its central address, waterfront surroundings, strong connectivity, and established urban infrastructure, Business Bay remains an attractive destination for both end-users and investors. Burj Binghatti adds an exceptional architectural landmark to this setting, combining exclusive residences, extraordinary views, and a distinctive luxury concept.

description: Reference: GTWW-T1265. We present a new generation residential development, designed to offer a truly exclusive lifestyle. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Reference: GTWW-T1372. Contemporary residential development located in Jumeirah Heights, Dubai, one of the most prestigious and well-positioned areas of the city, with direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and immediate proximity to reference areas such as Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Palm Jumeirah and the main business centres. The project is distinguished by its elegant and fluid architecture, marked by curved lines and a careful selection of materials, designed to create a harmonious connection between nature, water and urban landscape. The building's location favours expansive views of the waterfront, garden areas and the Dubai skyline, providing a sophisticated and bright experience. The rooms were designed to offer comfort, functionality and superior quality, with generous floor plans, large glazed surfaces and contemporary finishes that enhance natural light and the feeling of space. The development has 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive penthouses, suitable for both own residence and investment. The common areas present a complete concept of leisure, well-being and convenience, spread over several levels, including: Adult, family, and children's pools, with rest areas, loungers, and cabanas Social club with lounges, bar, private cinema, and game spaces Coworking spaces with meeting rooms, individual workstations, and collaborative areas Wellness centre with spa, sauna, Turkish bath, massage rooms, yoga, Pilates, and relaxation areas Double-height gym, with cardio, strength, callisthenics, cycling and climbing wall areas Dance studio and outdoor areas for physical activities Padel courts, gardens, squares and social spaces Dedicated children's areas, with indoor and outdoor areas, children's pool and lounge for parents Pet-friendly infrastructures, including play and washing areas Bicycle and motorcycle parking, electric vehicle chargers and independent car wash On the ground floor, the development includes a selection of shops, restaurants, cafes and supermarket, ensuring maximum convenience in everyday life and a dynamic relationship with the urban surroundings. With freehold property, parking spaces assigned according to typology and expected completion in the last quarter of 2029, this project represents a solid opportunity for both housing and investment, combining premium location, differentiating architecture and a high standard of services. title: Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain
raw_area: Siniyah Island, Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, Umm Al Quwain
description: Seafront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniya Island, located in Umm Al Quwain, is an emerging residential and leisure destination renowned for its tranquil natural beauty and serene island atmosphere. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and pristine beaches, it provides a unique blend of relaxation and adventure, featuring exclusive residential communities, luxurious amenities, and diverse recreational options such as golfing, water sports, and eco-tourism activities. Its strategic position, away from the city's bustle yet conveniently accessible, makes it an ideal retreat for residents seeking tranquility combined with modern comfort. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious coastal living experience, prominently featuring pristine natural beaches, serene lagoon beaches, and vibrant landscaped parks. Its exterior design is elegantly set along a mesmerizing shoreline with four distinct towers, each with breathtaking views of the turquoise waters and lush greenery. The community is enriched by world-class amenities including an infinity swimming pool, a state-of-the-art fitness center, children's play areas, an outdoor cinema, and a community center. For adventure enthusiasts, thrilling water sports such as snorkeling, scuba diving, and kite surfing are readily available. Additional sophisticated conveniences include an exclusive yacht club, a vibrant retail boulevard with open-air cafés and gourmet dining options, an upscale shopping mall, and luxurious resorts. Connectivity is ensured by a picturesque 1.7 km bridge, providing easy access from the urban landscape to the island's tranquility. The project offers meticulously designed interiors that blend contemporary luxury with practical elegance, available in configurations of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Tower A residences are fully furnished, providing immediate comfort and sophisticated style from day one, while Towers B, C, and D are delivered semi-furnished, allowing residents flexibility to personalize their spaces. Each apartment is thoughtfully planned, featuring spacious layouts complemented by premium finishes and fixtures. All units come equipped with fitted wardrobes, providing both functionality and aesthetic appeal, and modern kitchens fitted with high-quality white goods, enhancing convenience and elegance. Expansive windows and private balconies optimize natural lighting and allow residents to enjoy serene views of the surrounding natural landscapes, pristine beaches, and tranquil lagoons. The interiors encapsulate a refined lifestyle, with attention to detail evident in every corner, creating a harmonious environment tailored for ultimate comfort and style. UAQ-00006

title: Sector 3, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1353. The development located in Business Bay, Dubai, was conceived as an ultra-luxurious residential tower that asserts itself as one of the tallest and most exclusive housing structures in the world. The building features a striking architecture, inspired by the universe of high jewellery, which is reflected in sculptural shapes, metal inserts, worked decorative elements and meticulous attention to every aesthetic detail. The concept favours not only visual grandeur, but also the creation of sophisticated interiors, highly customisable and developed to offer a level of comfort and refinement rarely found in the residential market. The composition of the tower integrates different categories of housing, aimed at diversified profiles of residents. The initial typologies include two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, designed with functional layouts and a contemporary language, while always maintaining high standards of materials and finishes. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. On the upper levels, typologies of a frankly exclusive character emerge, such as the suspended mansions of four and six bedrooms, which occupy generous areas and provide a true experience of an independent house within a vertical tower. Some of these units include a private pool, cinema rooms, play areas, reading spaces and areas for wellness activities, such as rooms prepared for massages or fully equipped gyms. These residences are also distinguished by the high number of private parking spaces, which can vary between four and twelve, ensuring safety and practicality. At the top of the structure are the most emblematic residences of the project: large penthouses designed in full floors or in duplexes, with exceptional surfaces that far exceed the typical dimensions of luxury apartments. These units include infinity pools with panoramic views, formal and informal dining areas, main kitchens and secondary kitchens for service, private gyms, games rooms, offices, private lounges, suites with walk-in wardrobes, bathrooms covered in noble materials and protected outdoor areas to enjoy the view over the city. In some cases, residents have a private lift with direct access to the interior of the unit, ensuring the highest level of privacy. The building offers an extensive set of amenities that reinforce its position as a reference in the luxury real estate sector. These include large-design outdoor pools, a spa with treatment rooms, a sauna, a Turkish bath and relaxation areas, a gym equipped with state-of-the-art technology, lounges reserved for residents, meeting rooms and social spaces designed for private events. The tower also has concierge services available daily, valet assistance, permanent security staff, high-standard reception and advanced access control systems. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. The location in Business Bay guarantees a privileged connection to strategic areas of Dubai, such as Downtown, Dubai Canal, financial centres, cultural areas and some of the city's most popular gastronomic and commercial destinations. The proximity to the main traffic routes offers quick accessibility to the airport, beaches and other central neighbourhoods, making the development an ideal option for both permanent residence and investment. Taken together, this tower represents a unique proposition in Dubai's real estate landscape: it combines extremely refined design, typologies adapted to different lifestyles, international standard services and a highly prestigious location. description:
AG Ark is a residential project by AG Properties in Dubai Land Residence Complex. The building comprises two basement levels, a ground floor, 13 residential floors and a roof level. Homes span studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with sizes starting from 387 sq ft. The tower has a contemporary exterior with projecting balconies, with the listed one-bedroom homes ranging from 846 to 1,215 sq ft.

Homes include smart home systems and kitchens equipped with appliances, alongside modern interior finishes. Shared facilities include a rooftop swimming pool, gym, meditation area and children's playroom. Cabanas, family sitting areas, barbecue spaces and an outdoor cinema provide places to spend time outside the apartment. The location is stated as five minutes from Dubai Outlet Mall, 15 minutes from Dubai Mall and 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport.

The project suits buyers looking for a smart home in Dubai Land Residence Complex with payments extending beyond completion. The payment plan allocates 20% on booking, 30% during construction, 1% on handover and 49% after handover. Completion is expected in Q4 2027. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department and has an escrow account with Emirates NBD.

title: 78Q2+2Q, Dubai
description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

title: Emaar Ocean Star
description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.
The development includes 154 residential apartments, comprising 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom homes. The apartments feature practical layouts, spacious living areas and private balconies or terraces, with a range of configurations to suit different household needs. The supplied floor plans cover 38 layout variations, with total apartment areas ranging from approximately 789.9 to 2,025 sq ft.
One-bedroom apartments offer efficient layouts with private outdoor space, while two-bedroom residences provide additional room for families and shared living. Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. The combination of indoor living space and private outdoor areas contributes to the development's residential appeal.
Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

description: Beachfront Apartments with a 4-Year Payment Plan on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi Saadiyat Island, just off the coast of Abu Dhabi, is a premier destination known for its cultural, residential, and leisure attractions. It is home to iconic landmarks like the Louvre Abu Dhabi, the upcoming Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, and the Zayed National Museum. With pristine beaches, luxury resorts, and world-class amenities, the island offers a unique lifestyle. Its upscale villas, apartments, and townhouses often have stunning sea views and beach access, attracting both residents and investors. The , are located just 2 minutes from Soul Beach, 5 minutes from the Louvre Abu Dhabi and Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, 7 minutes from the Zayed National Museum, 10 minutes from Saadiyat Beach, 30 minutes from Abu Dhabi International Airport, and 60 minutes from the Burj Khalifa. The project offers a resort-inspired lifestyle with roof gardens, a fragrance garden, an event lawn, and shaded seating areas. It is equipped with a state-of-the-art gym, a cinema, coworking and outdoor workspaces, and meditation zones. Families enjoy kids' swimming pools, a Kids' Club, and play areas, all complemented by concierge and valet services. Residents can also benefit from services like housekeeping, pet sitting, rental and cooking management, pool maintenance, barber and salon services, fitness and swimming classes, and laundry options. The sustainable project incorporates drought-resistant native plants and eco-friendly features like bicycle facilities and pedestrian-friendly spaces. The elegant apartments come with 2- and 3-bedroom layouts. Each unit has fitted wardrobes and premium white goods to ensure convenience and functionality. The living spaces have options for both light and dark interior schemes. Wide windows allow for an abundance of natural light and connects residents to the tranquil views of Saadiyat Island. Bathrooms are fitted with sleek, contemporary fixtures. The overall design emphasizes both luxury and comfort to create an inviting home atmosphere. AUH-00011

description: Sei Saadiyat: 1-bedroom apartment offering approximately 78 sq m of space within a new residential development by Aldar in Saadiyat Cultural District, Abu Dhabi. The residence features a light interior palette with stone, wood, metal and woven textures, combined with clean forms and carefully balanced proportions. The development comprises six towers and 778 residences. The architectural concept was created by Jacobs, while the interiors were designed by Kettle Collective. The project combines stepped building volumes, landscaped courtyards, elevated gardens and a façade treatment shaped by light and shadow. Sei Saadiyat is located in the heart of Saadiyat Cultural District, approximately 3 minutes from Abrahamic Family House, 4 minutes from Zayed National Museum, and around 5 minutes from Louvre Abu Dhabi, Manarat Al Saadiyat, Berklee Abu Dhabi and Saadiyat Grove. Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi and teamLab Phenomena are about 7 minutes away, while Yas Island is around 20 minutes and Zayed International Airport approximately 25 minutes away. With approximately 78 sq m of space, the 1-bedroom format is well suited to owner-occupiers and buyers considering future rental within Saadiyat Cultural District. Its proximity to the island's major cultural landmarks is one of the project's defining advantages. Handover is scheduled for Q4 2030 . The payment plan is structured as 50/50 , with 5% payable on booking, 45% during construction and the remaining 50% on handover. A key advantage of Sei Saadiyat is the combination of an Aldar development, a prime cultural district location and a distinctive architectural concept. Contact DDA Real Estate for current pricing, available layouts and full purchase details for this 1-bedroom apartment at Sei Saadiyat.

description: Altus by Emaar is a contemporary residential development designed to bring together modern elegance, urban convenience, and sustainable living. Featuring thoughtfully designed residences and a distinctive architectural style, the development offers a refined lifestyle complemented by expansive views and well-planned living spaces. With an emphasis on natural light, functionality, and environmental responsibility, Altus presents a modern approach to comfortable city living. The development offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, catering to individuals, couples, and families. Each home is designed with spacious layouts, contemporary bathrooms, generous storage, and balconies that extend the living experience outdoors. The interiors combine modern aesthetics with practical design, creating inviting spaces suited to everyday comfort and relaxation. Altus features fully finished residences with high-quality materials and equipped kitchens, allowing residents to enjoy a contemporary living environment with essential kitchen facilities in place. The apartments are unfurnished, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalise their interiors according to their preferences. Sustainability is an integral part of the development's design. Architectural features such as balconies, horizontal ledges, and tinted glazing help reduce direct solar exposure and support cooler indoor environments. The design also incorporates measures to preserve existing vegetation and improve water efficiency, including the collection of air-conditioning condensate and planter drainage for landscape irrigation. These thoughtful features reflect a commitment to creating a comfortable living environment while considering long-term environmental impact. Spanning approximately eight square kilometres, the destination combines contemporary residences, landscaped open spaces, waterfront promenades, and lifestyle attractions in a thoughtfully designed urban environment. A major highlight is Creek Beach, a family-friendly waterfront destination featuring approximately 700 metres of white sand, leisure spaces, and opportunities to enjoy the outdoors. The surrounding community offers a blend of waterfront experiences, dining, retail, and recreational attractions, creating an appealing lifestyle for residents of different ages. Dubai Creek Harbour is also known for its ambitious architectural vision and connection to the historic Dubai Creek. Its combination of modern urban planning, waterfront scenery, and access to key destinations makes it attractive to both homeowners and investors seeking a contemporary address in Dubai. With its sustainable design features, modern interiors, and waterfront community setting, Altus by Emaar offers a distinctive residential experience that balances comfort, functionality, and contemporary elegance.

Strategically located along the Dubai Canal, it offers breathtaking skyline views, including the iconic Burj Khalifa. The area is a hub for business, leisure, and lifestyle, featuring world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options. With excellent connectivity via major highways and the metro, Business Bay attracts professionals, investors, and residents seeking a modern urban lifestyle with easy access to Downtown Dubai and other key destinations. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street. A wellness club, beauty salon, kids' daycare, snooker zone, and library provide additional comfort and relaxation. The development also includes a business centre, indoor gyms, jogging track, bowling center, and outdoor cinema, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle for its residents. Each apartment is equipped with fitted wardrobes in the bedrooms and kitchen white goods, including a refrigerator, cooker, and washing machine, ensuring ease and functionality. The modern kitchens are designed with sleek cabinetry and high-quality materials for a sophisticated look. Additionally, the apartments offer the option of private pools on the balcony, giving residents the opportunity to enjoy stunning views while experiencing the ultimate in privacy and luxury. The bathrooms are designed with premium fixtures and finishes, further elevating the overall living experience. With every detail meticulously planned, these apartments provide the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style for those looking to live in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Business Bay. description: Project general facts New Project is an elegant mixed-use residential tower that blends contemporary architecture with a warm, welcoming sense of home. raw_area: Siniyah Island, Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, Umm Al Quwain
description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. The project offers elegantly designed interiors across a selection of premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, carefully crafted to blend modern comfort with sophisticated aesthetics. Each residence features contemporary layouts enhanced by spacious living areas and meticulous attention to detail. The interiors are equipped with stylish fitted wardrobes and fully integrated kitchen appliances, providing residents with convenience and luxury. Tower A exclusively offers fully furnished units, thoughtfully curated with tasteful furnishings and décor for immediate comfort and sophisticated living from day one. Towers B, C, and D present semi-furnished residences, allowing flexibility for personal touches to complement the refined interiors. Every apartment has been designed to create a harmonious living space that emphasizes both elegance and functionality, offering residents an exceptional lifestyle experience in a vibrant coastal setting. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

Its bold yet fluid form is complemented by lush tropical landscaping and flowing water features that embrace a serene promenade. At its core, this development offers a curated lifestyle of wellness and luxury, with world-class amenities such as a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, infinity pool, children's pool, padel court, jogging track, family lawn, and scenic garden spaces. Thoughtfully designed terraces and curved balconies frame uninterrupted panoramic sea views and golden sunsets, while tranquil zones like the activity lawn, sunken seating areas, and waterscapes foster relaxation and community. Each apartment features thoughtfully planned layouts with generous living spaces, high ceilings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the interiors with natural light while offering sweeping views of the sea. description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. Residences come with fully fitted kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, as well as built-in wardrobes that maximize storage while maintaining sleek, modern aesthetics. description: Luxury Apartments with Burj Khalifa Views in Business Bay Business Bay in Dubai is a vibrant, fast-growing business and residential hub located along the Dubai Canal, close to Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa. Known for its modern skyscrapers, upscale hotels, and luxury residential towers, it offers a mix of commercial spaces, premium office buildings, and high-end apartments. The area is home to world-class amenities such as fine dining, shopping centers, and entertainment options, making it a sought-after location for professionals and families.
