title: Sector 3, Dubai
description: Reference: GTWW-T1286. It presents a large-scale, ultra-luxury residential tower located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, an architectural landmark that combines futuristic design, exceptional proportions and high-quality materials. Designed according to a principle of sensory purity, the project combines emotion and rationality, offering residential units that privilege serenity, natural light and the harmonious integration between form and functionality. Located in one of the most prestigious areas of the city, the building is just a few minutes from the main landmarks: 3 kilometres from the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Mall, 7 minutes from the Dubai International Financial Centre, 3 minutes from the Dubai Opera and 15 minutes from the public beach of Jumeirah. The strategic position between Downtown Dubai and Business Bay ensures expansive and unobstructed views, as well as immediate access to the city's main thoroughfares. The tower rises to 341 meters in height and consists of 3 underground floors, ground floor, 5 podium floors and 65 upper floors, which include 51 residential floors and 3 dedicated to amenities, in addition to a health club and infinity pool. The project includes a total of 150 units, including two- and three-bedroom suites and four, five- and six-bedroom penthouses, including duplex and triplex options. Units can be purchased furnished or unfurnished and ownership is freehold. The ceilings have a height of 4.2 meters, reinforcing the spacious and sophisticated character of the interior spaces. The interior design highlights the use of noble materials such as travertine, walnut wood, selected marble, technical glass, chrome and handcrafted elements. The elegant lines and fluid geometry reflect a contemporary approach that favours comfort, refinement and visual balance. In addition to aesthetic care, the building incorporates smart sustainability solutions, including photovoltaic panels integrated into the façade, advanced air conditioning and acoustic systems, charging points for electric vehicles and planning aimed at obtaining environmental certification. The complex offers a full range of services and amenities, such as panoramic pools, private pools in specific units, spa, gym, concierge services, valet, housekeeping, exclusive parking for penthouses, leisure areas and home automation systems. These services ensure a highly differentiated standard of living oriented towards absolute comfort. The two-bedroom typologies vary between 170 m² and 305 m², depending on the floor, and may include a private pool, large balconies, equipped kitchens and, in some cases, a maid. The three-bedroom units stand out for their generous areas, the possibility of a private pool and double kitchens. The penthouses, with amplified areas and unique layouts, include features such as cinema rooms, games rooms, private gyms, jacuzzis, double closets, indoor and outdoor pools, massage rooms and spaces designed to provide a residential experience at the level of the highest international standards. This development represents a paradigmatic landmark of contemporary architecture in Dubai, combining technical innovation, refined aesthetics and unparalleled views. It is a product aimed at buyers looking for exclusivity, distinction, advanced engineering and a truly exceptional lifestyle. #ref:8989

title: Downtown Dubai, Dubai
raw_area: Downtown Dubai, Downtown Dubai, Dubai, Dubai
description: Mercedes-Benz-Inspired Luxury Apartments in Downtown Dubai UAE Downtown Dubai is a globally renowned iconic city center, where modern architectural wonders, luxury shopping malls, and vibrant night views converge. The world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa, is located in this area. Moreover, it hosts one of the world's largest shopping and entertainment complexes, such as The Dubai Mall. Downtown Dubai offers a contemporary and luxurious city experience with its chic hotels, fine dining restaurants, and expansive green spaces. Inspired by the Mercedes-Benz brand, the hypertower is located in the heart of Dubai. This project offers luxury living at the most important point in the city, with direct access to Dubai's main roads and within walking distance of the city's main tourist attractions. The are a 14-minute walk to the Dubai Canal and a 16-minute walk to Dubai Mall. In addition, the apartments are 4 minutes to the Business Bay metro station, 28 minutes to Palm Jumeirah, and 21 minutes to Dubai International Airport. The apartments are situated in the new iconic building in Dubai, which is the world's first and only Mercedes-Benz-branded residential tower. The tower is 341 meters high and has 65 floors, consisting of a total of 150 apartments. The apartments come in different models, including 2 and 3-bedroom suites and 4 and 5-bedroom penthouse. One of the most important features of this exclusive project is that each apartment has a ceiling height of 4.2 meters, offering views of both the Burj Khalifa and the magnificent Dubai skyline. The project includes 4 floors dedicated to social facilities and entertainment areas. Smart building and home systems, a spa and fitness center, a swimming pool on the podium level, an infinity pool on the higher floors, housekeeping, valet services, special sound insulation, and solar panel systems are available. Additionally, the project supports sustainable living and is LEED-certified. Each apartment comes with wardrobes, ceiling finishes, kitchen furniture, and high-quality kitchen appliances (refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, oven, and ice maker). In addition, the apartments feature private swimming pools, jacuzzis, and bathtubs, while penthouses have private parking within the unit. Apartment types; 2-bedroom Mercedes-Benz Pagoda Suite apartments are between 169 sqm-237 sqm in size. There are 80 units in total in the project. 3-bedroom Grand Mercedes-Benz Suite apartments vary in size between 254 sqm-300 sqm. There are 57 units in total in the project. 4-bedroom Mercedes-Benz One-Eleven Penthouse apartments are 370 sqm. There are 8 units in the project. 5-bedroom Mercedes-Benz Gullwing Penthouse apartments are 650 sqm. There are 3 units in the project. Two specially designed 1000 sqm and 1400 sqm penthouses are located at the top of the tower and are among the most luxurious apartments ever in Dubai. For the first time in the world, contact us for launch and early purchase opportunities for luxury Mercedes-Benz apartments only in Downtown Dubai. DXB-00054

This central location allows residents to enjoy both the city's corporate core and its beachfront and leisure destinations with equal convenience. The project distinguishes itself through a hospitality-inspired lifestyle concept supported by extensive social amenities. The project includes resort-style swimming pools, dedicated fitness and wellness facilities, landscaped green spaces including a 2 km inner walking loop, and sports courts such as padel and squash. Social lounges, co-working areas, and curated retail and dining outlets further enhance the sense of community. Choosing to purchase an apartment from this project means securing a home in a prime live-work-play destination, where high professional demand, limited central land supply, and long-term urban planning contribute to sustained value and desirability. More broadly, acquiring property in Dubai offers a combination of investment potential and elevated lifestyle. The city's global connectivity, strong rental market in prime areas, and reputation for safety and infrastructure continue to attract international buyers. description: Gianfranco Ferré Branded Apartments with Installments in Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, stretching gracefully into the Arabian Gulf and offering a world-class blend of leisure, luxury, and lifestyle. Comprising four coral-shaped islands, it is home to pristine white-sand beaches, turquoise waters, and an array of upscale hotels, branded residences, and premium retail and dining options. Known as one of the UAE's most sought-after waterfront destinations, Al Marjan Island attracts residents and investors alike with its resort-style living, breathtaking sea views, and proximity to vibrant leisure attractions, making it a prime location for both vacation homes and long-term investments. , are ideally located just 2 minutes from Wynn Resort, 12 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 13 minutes from RAK Central, 14 minutes from Al Hamra Golf Club, 16 minutes from the Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah, 30 minutes from RAK Mall and Al Qawasim Corniche, 35 minutes from RAK International Airport, 50 minutes from Sharjah International Airport, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai. Positioned at the very tip of Al Marjan Island and surrounded by the Arabian Gulf on three sides, this Gianfranco Ferré branded waterfront development showcases a U-shaped architectural design to maximize uninterrupted sea views from every residence. The exterior blends contemporary elegance with resort-style living, featuring landscaped gardens, sun decks, and private terraces with pools in select apartments. Residents enjoy hotel-style services and a wealth of premium amenities, including separate rooftop pools for men and women, a family pool near a children's play area, dedicated Technogym-equipped fitness zones for men and women, and access to sandy beaches and water sports. Social and leisure spaces include a lobby café, a ground-floor retail zone, and two fine-dining restaurants with panoramic views. Additional conveniences such as 24-hour concierge and valet parking, round-the-clock housekeeping, and discreet security ensure comfort and peace of mind. The project's prime location offers direct access to the region's first casino and is within walking distance of luxury hotels, cafés, and restaurants, placing residents in the heart of Ras Al Khaimah's newest entertainment and lifestyle hub. The project presents fully branded and furnished apartments by Gianfranco Ferré Home, crafted in Italy with a signature blend of architectural precision and timeless elegance. description: Apartments with Burj Khalifa Views and Installment in Downtown Dubai Downtown Dubai is the city's most iconic and prestigious district, renowned for its world-class landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai Opera. It offers a dynamic blend of upscale residential living, high-end retail, fine dining, and cultural experiences-all within walking distance. With its central location, seamless connectivity via the Dubai Metro, and breathtaking skyline and waterfront views, Downtown Dubai represents the epitome of urban sophistication and is one of the most sought-after addresses for both residents and investors. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street, 4 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 7 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 10 minutes from Dubai Opera, 12 minutes from Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The project is a 55-storey residential tower situated in the heart of Downtown Dubai, masterfully designed to harmonize contemporary architecture with the tranquility of nature. Rising to 277 meters, the tower offers breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Fountain, and Dubai Water Canal. The exterior incorporates sustainable design elements such as self-shading balconies and lush greenery to promote biodiversity and enhance air quality. Residents enjoy an exceptional range of resort-style amenities, including a 60-meter infinity pool, a 40-meter adults-only rooftop pool with skyline views, a state-of-the-art Fairmont Fit gym, spa with massage rooms, steam and sauna, indoor and outdoor yoga areas, a padel court, golf simulator, and serene zen gardens. Leisure and social spaces feature a private cinema, entertainment lounge, rooftop bar, fine-dining restaurant, and an exclusive owner's lounge. For families, the development includes dedicated kids' pools, play areas, and clubs for all ages. Additionally, residents benefit from premium concierge services, private dining spaces, meeting rooms, and a wide array of à la carte hospitality services inspired by Fairmont's world-renowned standards. The project features a limited collection of 246 apartments, including 2, 3, and 4-bedroom units as well as two ultra-luxury 5-bedroom duplex penthouses-each offering expansive terraces, floor-to-ceiling windows, and breathtaking dual-facing views of Burj Khalifa, Dubai Fountain, or Dubai Water Canal. Interiors are meticulously crafted to reflect a seamless blend of elegance and functionality, with high ceilings up to 3.65 meters enhancing natural light and spatial flow. All units are delivered fully fitted and include premium German Miele kitchen appliances, integrated white goods, and sleek fitted wardrobes. Natural materials such as stone, wood, and marble elevate the finishes, while spacious layouts and open-plan living areas ensure both refined comfort and effortless entertaining. All residences, except the 2-bedroom layouts, also include a maid's room, offering practical luxury in the heart of Dubai's most prestigious district. DXB-00246

description: Luxury Properties with Private Pools in the Tallest Residential Tower in Business Bay in Dubai Dubai, renowned for its luxury and iconic architecture, stands as one of the world's most coveted destinations for both vacations and upscale living. Now, you can experience this exclusivity at Burj Binghatti Jacob & Co Residences , where architectural innovation meets ultimate luxury. Imagine living above the clouds in the world's tallest residential tower-these meticulously designed residences offer unique, high-end properties with exquisite finishes, redefining luxury living on a global scale. Burj Binghatti Jacob & Co project stands 555 meters tall, featuring 299 exclusive properties within a 100-storey building and 4 sky gardens. Each property offers panoramic views of Dubai and includes a private pool. The Hypertower boasts a range of premium social amenities, including a café-bar, valet parking, fitness center, game rooms, chef-run restaurants, ballrooms, sky gardens, and a communal outdoor pool. The tower is equipped with 16 elevators and offers a smart home system with voice control (compatible with Amazon Alexa, Google, and Apple). Additionally, it features an electronic curtain system with energy-saving capabilities based on daylight, as well as high-end glass and coating materials for superior interior and exterior insulation. , are located in one of the city's most vibrant and dynamic districts, known for its thriving business environment and stunning waterfront views, and it's just 3 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall,15 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 27 minutes from The Palm Jumeirah. Marble and natural stone are used on all the In addition, some interior details are finished by Zaha Hadid Design. In the extensive project, there are 6 property types, as below. Emerald / Sapphire Villa / Ruby Villa: 140 Properties Located between the 12th and 82nd floors of Hypertower, there are 4 two or three-bedroom properties on each floor. These properties have amazing panoramic views of Dubai Downtown. In the interior, the properties have Miele brand white goods (oven, stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, washing machine, ice maker, microwave), marble floors, and a 28 m² private pool. They have a 160 m² living area and a 150 m² balcony. The properties have 2 parking spaces. Fleur De Jardin Sky Mansions: 24 Properties Spacious 6-bedroom properties are located between the 83rd and 96th floors of Hypertower, with 2 properties on each floor. With a total area of 650 m², 480 m² is allocated for living space and 170 m² for balconies. Miele brand white goods (oven, stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, washing machine, ice maker, microwave), marble floors, and 28 m² private pool designed as an infinity pool with panoramic views of Dubai city. Unlike other properties, it has 4 parking spaces. Astronomia Sky Penthouse: 2 Properties The ultra-luxury penthouse properties are the only ones on the floor and are located on the 100th and 101st floor of Hypertower. They have a total floor area of 1100 m², including 950 m² net and 150 m² balcony area. The luxury properties have two private pools of 28-50 m², a sauna, gym, steam room, office, guest reception areas, and different living areas. From the properties, it is possible to taste 360-degree panoramic views of Dubai and enjoy a 50 m², private infinity pool with a height of 500 meters. Billionaire Sky Penthouse: Single Property It is the world's tallest duplex property, located on the 102nd and 103rd floor of Hypertower. It has a total of 2000 m² and 12 parking spaces, a 50 m² infinity pool, and offers matchless panoramic views of Dubai. This unique property has its cinema, billiard room, café, bar, lounge area, staff room, office, gym, sauna, steam room, game room, and many other special areas. DXB-00001

title: The World Islands, Dubai
description: Project general facts It is a private island resort community conceived as a curated collection of waterfront homes, where every journey begins with a sea crossing to a dedicated arrival jetty. Low-rise residential buildings with sweeping curved terraces and layered, sculpted balconies wrap around sandy beaches, lagoons and boat moorings, so that most homes look directly onto open water and the city skyline. The residential offering ranges from compact studios to one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, crowned by a limited collection of exclusive penthouses and complemented by a separate villa collection of Ocean Floating Villas set directly on the water, Light House Villas and Tree Villas framed by landscaped gardens. Island life is organised around leisure by the sea. Residents have access to a refined beach club with loungers and shaded cabanas, several swimming pools, a floating restaurant with panoramic water views, a retail promenade designed as a lifestyle destination, a dedicated fitness studio and a kids play area built around a central tree sculpture. Larger residences enjoy wraparound open-air balconies with private plunge pools or jacuzzis, outdoor lounges, sunbeds, outdoor dining zones and wellness corners, while a dedicated welcome centre marks the start of the resident and guest journey to the island. Interiors follow a calm resort palette of sand, ivory and warm timber, with marble surfaces, soft curved furniture and floor-to-ceiling glazing that opens living rooms and bedrooms to the sea. Open-plan living and dining areas lead to show kitchens, master bedrooms are paired with walk-in dressing areas and bathrooms, and the largest homes add maid rooms, storage and separate powder rooms, creating a polished, hotel-inspired setting throughout. Location description and benefits The World Islands is an exclusive man-made archipelago set off the Jumeirah coastline, where individual islands are arranged in the outline of a world map. The location offers a rare sense of seclusion while staying within sight of the city: Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Bay and the Downtown Dubai skyline all sit on the horizon, and the surrounding waters are lined with some of the most prestigious resort and residential addresses in Dubai. Access to the islands is by sea, with boat transfers and water taxis connecting to marinas and jetties along the Jumeirah coast, and private yacht arrivals adding to the resort-style experience. Once ashore on the mainland, Jumeirah Beach Road and Sheikh Zayed Road link residents to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Dubai Marina and both international airports, while premium schools, clinics, beach clubs, fine dining and the leading shopping malls of the city are all within easy reach. The World Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers, positioned at the very top of the Dubai luxury market. The scarcity of private island homes, strong appeal to high-net-worth buyers and the steady demand for exclusive holiday homes and premium short-stay rentals make the location well suited both for a personal seaside retreat and for long-term capital preservation. Contact: Mayank

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Luxury Wellness Apartments with Premium Amenities for Sale in Majan, Dubai Majan represents one of Dubai's greenest and most nature-focused residential communities. Known for its serene atmosphere, lush natural greenery, and tranquil surroundings, this prime location offers residents a peaceful lifestyle retreat away from busy city life while remaining conveniently close to key urban centers. Designed with a clear focus on health and vitality, the district provides a unique blend of fresh natural environments, peaceful neighborhood settings, and modern suburban convenience, making it an ideal residential destination for families, health-conscious buyers, and forward-thinking property investors. The benefits from outstanding regional connectivity across Dubai and neighboring emirates, offering direct highway access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), Al Ain Road (E66), and Emirates Road (E611). Residents also enjoy convenient public transit access, being situated just 4 minutes away from the upcoming Gold Line Metro station. This strategic position ensures rapid, stress-free commuting to major commercial hubs, international airports, popular shopping destinations, and key entertainment landmarks throughout the emirate. Crafted as a comprehensive wellness ecosystem, the development features over 200,000 square feet of curated lifestyle spaces housing 65 exclusive amenities spread across eight dedicated floors. Key outdoor and indoor facilities include a 1-kilometer floating forest skywalk elevated 50 meters above ground level, crystal waterfalls, natural hot springs, hydrotherapy pools, ice baths, and a therapeutic salt cave. The community podiums further offer an outdoor co-working space, skyline clubhouse, lush botanical gardens, lazy river, kayaking pool, rock climbing wall, and dedicated studios for fitness, dance, and martial arts. The residences range from studios to 3.5-bedroom units, with every interior detail scientifically engineered for long-term health and well-being. Apartment interiors feature HEPA and UVC air filtration systems, active humidity control, electromagnetic frequency shielding, noise insulation, and circadian rhythm lighting. Bathrooms are equipped with Vitamin C showers and high-grade water purification, while kitchens offer low-VOC finishes, antibacterial surfaces, charcoal anti-odor technology, and integrated white goods. description: This project is a G+2 Podium+1 Amenity Floor+13 Residential Floors+Rooftop tower rising in the heart of Liwan (Wadi Al Safa 2), Dubai.  The building's sculpted, wave-form façade with continuous LED-lit balconies gives it an unmistakable presence on the Liwan skyline, while its curated collection of 147 residences - studios, and one, two and three-bedroom apartments ranging from roughly 371 to 1,820 sq. ft. - is designed, in the developer's words, "for effortless living."  Studios start from approximately AED 591,000,  one-bedrooms from AED 1.13 million,  two-bedrooms (with maid's room) from AED 1.89 million,  and three-bedrooms (with maid's room) from AED 2.38 million,  Flexible 60/40 pre-handover payment plan or 62/38  post-handover payment plan (38 months of 1%/month to be paid post-handover) and handover scheduled for Q4 2028. The interiors follow a modern design philosophy built around simplicity, functionality and elegance. Each residence is planned to maximise natural light and a sense of openness, with clean-lined layouts, warm neutral palettes, and a refined material mix of book-matched marble and natural stone feature walls, fluted timber panelling, and soft ambient cove lighting. Bedrooms are finished with upholstered headboard walls, sculptural pendant fixtures, and integrated wardrobes or dedicated dressing areas in the larger units, while bathrooms feature marble-clad walls, rainfall showers, sleek pedestal or countertop basins, and bronze-toned fittings for a spa-like finish.  Kitchens are fully fitted with handleless, fluted cabinetry and a complete built-in appliance package - four-burner hob, cooker hood, oven, microwave, dishwasher (from one-bedroom units up), integrated fridge-freezer, washing machine, and a 65-inch TV with wall bracket .

description: Reference: GTWW-T1231. Discover a new residential icon in the heart of Dubai: a stunning 210 m² 3-bedroom maid bedroom with sea views, set in a 450-metre-high, 109-storey tower that redefines the concept of living above the city. Located on the prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road, this development provides a unique urban experience, combining excellent architecture, stunning panoramic views and direct access to Dubai's most important areas. Just minutes from Business Bay, DIFC, Downtown and Jumeirah Beach, it ensures mobility, convenience and the possibility of living in the centre of it all. This spacious flat is designed as a luxury family retreat, where spaciousness, natural light and comfort meet. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame stunning views of the sea and skyline, while the private balcony prolongs the sense of integration with the landscape. The extra room for maid has been carefully planned to offer autonomy, functionality and privacy, and can also serve as an office, studio or multipurpose space, meeting the needs of modern families who value organisation and versatility without compromising style or comfort. The interiors stand out for their premium finishes: porcelain floors, a fully equipped kitchen with appliances from recognised brands and bathrooms covered with high quality materials. The integrated technology allows you to control lighting and air conditioning, ensuring a modern, functional and comfortable environment in all areas. The tower offers four vertically distributed sky-parks, designed as independent universes suspended in the air. Spaces for family leisure, sports areas, wellness areas, tranquil gardens and a superior sky-park with an infinity pool at about 370 meters high provide unique experiences, combining nature, relaxation and impressive views of the sea and the city. The lobby was designed to convey serenity and grandeur, using stone, wood and metal elements that filter the light in a gentle way, creating a welcoming welcome from the first moment. Every detail of the building, from the lobby to the upper levels, was designed to reflect lightness, verticality and harmony with contemporary urban life. Scheduled for completion in December 2031, this 3-bedroom flat with extra room for maid and sea view represents a unique investment opportunity in one of Dubai's most prestigious and elevated residential projects. Here, every detail has been meticulously designed to offer a modern, balanced and sophisticated life, where the sea and the city become part of your daily life. #ref:8952_5

description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments Designed by Elie Saab on Al Marjan Island Al Marjan Island is a man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, featuring four coral-shaped islands in the Arabian Gulf. It is renowned for its pristine beaches, luxury waterfront developments, and world-class hospitality. The island hosts high-end residences, resorts, and the upcoming Wynn Resort and Casino, set to make it a global entertainment hub. With breathtaking sea views and private beaches, it offers a vibrant beachfront lifestyle. Al Marjan Island is a prime destination for investors and homeowners seeking upscale coastal living in the UAE. , are located 5 minutes from Wynn Resort, 9 minutes from the Ritz-Carlton, 11 minutes from Al Hamra Golf Club, 13 minutes from Rak Mall, 32 minutes from RAK International Airport, 45 minutes from Sharjah International Airport, 54 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 1 hour from Dubai Downtown and Burj Khalifa by car. The project features three elegantly tapered 18-story towers, offering panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf. Designed in collaboration with Elie Saab, the development seamlessly blends fashion, architecture, and luxury living. Its wave-inspired structure harmonizes with the coastal landscape, enhancing the island's serene ambiance. Residents enjoy an exclusive beachfront lifestyle with private beach access, an infinity grand pool, a children's pool, and a dedicated beach café. Wellness amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, a sky gym on the 18th floor, male and female spas, and a serenity park. The project also offers family-friendly spaces, signature lounges, a sky lounge, a sky pool with a deck on the 18th floor, a co-working space, and a variety of retail and dining options. The project offers exquisitely designed 2 and 3-bedroom residences, where every detail reflects elegance and refined craftsmanship. The interiors are meticulously curated to exude a sense of luxury, incorporating premium materials, sophisticated finishes, and bespoke detailing inspired by Elie Saab's signature aesthetic. The living spaces feature floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing natural light to flood the interiors while offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf. The open-plan kitchens are equipped with high-end white goods from Siemens or Miele, including a built-in fridge and freezer, built-in hob and oven, washing machine, and built-in dishwasher, seamlessly integrated into sleek cabinetry for a modern yet functional design. The bedrooms are designed as serene retreats, featuring fitted wardrobes for ample storage, while the master suites boast spa-inspired bathrooms with premium sanitary ware from Geberit and Gessi. The flooring and wall finishes incorporate rich textures, travertine marble-effect porcelain tiles, and soft greige oak wood veneer, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. Intricately designed boiserie panels, embossed with the Elie Saab monogram, add a distinctive touch of opulence to the interiors. The project also includes plush lounges, spacious dining areas, and expansive balconies, allowing residents to fully embrace a sophisticated beachfront lifestyle with an unparalleled blend of comfort and artistry. The kitchens are equipped with built-in appliances, the floors are in porcelain and wood (in the premium units), and the bathrooms have modern finishes, with brushed nickel hardware and tempered glass elements. Positioned on a rare double-corner plot with direct park and beach access, the Jacob & Co. Available layouts include studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed with open-plan living areas and generous balconies. title: Omniyat Vela Dorchester Collection
description:
Vela Dorchester Collection is developed by Omniyat on Marasi Bay in Business Bay, next to The Lana, Dorchester Collection, Dubai. The 150-metre tower rises over 30 floors and contains 38 residences: three- and four-bedroom Marina Residences and Sky Residences, three penthouses with double-height living areas and private pools, and a five-bedroom Sky Palace of 22,992 sq ft across the top three floors. The other residences measure between 4,253 and 11,727 sq ft. Foster + Partners is the architect and the Paris studio Gilles & Boissier designed the interiors.

Â 

Floor-to-ceiling glazing frames views over the marina and towards the Burj Khalifa, and the tower's L-shaped corner pools and sun decks wrap around the facade. Typical layouts pair a show kitchen with a separate back-of-house kitchen, a maid's room and a private lift lobby. Shared facilities include an infinity-edge lap pool, a triple-height gym, a cinema room, a children's room, meeting rooms and a spa suite with salon, with concierge, valet and round-the-clock security. Residents can also use the facilities at The Lana hotel, including its spa, through a membership programme, and the beach club at One at Palm Jumeirah.

Â 

The tower sits in the Burj Khalifa District, close to Downtown Dubai, with Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road both nearby. With only 38 homes it is a small building, and it continues Omniyat's work with Foster + Partners and Dorchester Collection that includes ORLA and The Lana. The payment plan asks 5% on booking, 55% during construction and 40% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2027

description:

The project has two towers, with 16 and 20 upper floors above a basement, ground floor and podium, and full-height glazing that opens the apartments to views over the marina. Master bedrooms have walk-in wardrobes, and larger layouts add a maid's room. Shared facilities include an infinity pool with yoga access, a kids' pool, indoor and outdoor gyms and a garden above the marina with shaded seating and barbecue pods. The wider community has a marina promenade with shops and cafÃ©s, a canal pool, a school, mosques, a spa and hotels, with the QE2 nearby. Al Shindagha is about 18 minutes away by car, Dubai International Airport about 20 minutes, Downtown Dubai about 25 minutes and Dubai Marina about 30 minutes.
